case_name: C. Balachandran and Others v State of Kerala and Others

statutes.act: Kerala Water Supply And Sewerage Act

holding: The decision of this Court in Jacob's case 1990 Indlaw SC 458 (supra) being not applicable to the case of the appellants, we are bound by the ratio laid down in the case of Umadevi 2006 Indlaw SC 125 (supra).
No person who was temporarily or casually been employed could be directed to be continued permanently. It would be creating another mode of public employment which is not permissible.
The appellants, in our opinion, thus, neither in law nor in equity were entitled to be reinstated in service.
